segments.text: Hello, my name is Vachan Kumawat. I am from Electrical Branch, second year.
As for the concerning issue with dogs,
I believe that coexistence between dogs and students of IIT campus is possible
and personally I did not have any incident with dogs
they have never stood in my way, not even barked at me that much
so I am kind of like neutral with them
as for my personal opinion for the dogs is
yes if there have been some incidents
I have seen it myself with some of my friends.
They are kind of right now in trauma due to them, so...
Can you share any incident that and what do you think like in general should dogs be allowed inside campus and hostels or should they be removed?
Inside the hostel I believe they should be removed.
It is very good for the dogs if they roam outside the hostels on the roads.
It's very fine. Everyone can move easily
But inside the hostel they should be removed
They even topple the dustbins
They bark at people who go inside canteens and stuff
So it would be better if they are removed from the hostel area
but it is fine if they live in campus
Near the SAC region or the MNC region
there have been many big groups of dogs
If they attack on somebody
Do you think if a dog ever attacks on you
So your opinion about dogs will change?
In my personal opinion, I think it might change because after any incident, a company is in trauma.
And that of course affects my decision.
So what do you think is the solution for people who are very pro-dogs and people who are afraid of dogs?
What do you think is the middle ground or the solution that campus authority can work on?
I guess relocation of dogs would be better in that case like spreading up the groups
but it is very easy for the dog's group to mingle again so it will be better if they
are relocated somewhere else.
If they want to introduce dogs on campus, they can introduce some new breed or you know
some friendlier type of dogs which are well vaccinated and stuff kind off.
So it would be easier for the campus community students, staff
as well as the dogs themselves
they can send the dogs to some community centers as well
So they can fix shelters for dogs?
Yes sheltered
And apart from that have you ever seen CCF something that exists in the campus
Campus Flora and Fauna one
yes
You're aware of that
Have you ever seen them actively taking any actions to
No, not yet. Yes there are feeding zones but they are located just near the garbage piles
I do not think anyone would go there to even feed any dog
So means that there are rules but they're not being implemented?
Yes and if there is a committee it should take actions wisely
Not put any location anywhere or like somewhere something like that
Any other confusion you'd like to talk about
Like any other incident or anything that you want to specifically talk about when it comes to dogs
Dogs as a creature is very friendly and loyal. I believe it has been a good friend sometimes
Let's say you are sitting at Gala Cafe, so sometimes you just feed the dog
It's nice because he always comes to you when you go next time there
Whenever you go there next time
It's good for mental health
Yes, mental health wise its fine
But yes, some people do share trauma so their perspective must also be heard and something for the dogs must be done.
